nodes.label: Watch Mode (--watch)
nodes.rationale: A 3s debounce waits for file activity to stop so a wave of parallel agent writes does not trigger a rebuild per file.

nodes.label: Post-Commit Auto-Rebuild Hook
nodes.rationale: Triggers once per commit with no background process, appends rather than replaces any existing hook, and ignores doc/image changes which need a manual --update.

nodes.label: Replace-on-Re-extract Build Merge
nodes.rationale: prune_sources is only for genuinely deleted files; changed files are reconciled by dropping their source_file from the base before merge, and root= keeps prune paths on the same base as merged nodes.

nodes.label: Cluster-Only Refresh
nodes.rationale: Self-contained re-clustering from an existing graph, because Steps 5-9 read intermediate files a prior cleanup already deleted (#1392).

nodes.label: Incremental --update Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Only new or changed files are re-extracted, saving tokens and time; code-only changes skip semantic extraction entirely.

nodes.label: Semantic Manifest Stamping
nodes.rationale: Only semantic files that actually produced output are stamped, and stale hashes on failed chunks are cleared, so content is never marked done and lost forever (#2015, #1948).

nodes.label: Semantic Extraction Cache (Step B0)
nodes.rationale: Prompt-stamped cache entries mean a graphify upgrade that changes the extraction prompt re-extracts instead of replaying, while unchanged prompts keep their entries (#1939).

nodes.label: Commit Hook and CLAUDE.md Integration Reference
nodes.norm_label: commit hook and claude.md integration reference

nodes.label: God-Node Domain Hint Prompt
nodes.rationale: A one-sentence Whisper initial prompt composed from god-node labels picks up domain vocabulary without an extra API call.

nodes.label: Gemini Semantic Extraction Backend
nodes.rationale: No API key is ever required or prompted for: Gemini is used only if GEMINI_API_KEY/GOOGLE_API_KEY is already set, otherwise the host agent itself is the LLM.

nodes.label: Post-Change Graph Refresh Rule
nodes.rationale: graphify update . is AST-only with no API cost; dirty graphify-out/ files after hooks or incremental updates are expected and not a reason to skip the graph.

nodes.label: Reflect / LESSONS.md Work Memory
nodes.rationale: A cheap deterministic session-start refresh of preferred sources, known dead ends, and prior corrections keeps later sessions from re-deriving failed paths.

nodes.label: save-result Feedback Loop
nodes.rationale: Saving each answer with its expanded-token trace and an outcome (useful/dead_end/corrected) closes the loop so the next --update extracts the Q&A as a graph node.

nodes.label: Constrained Query Vocabulary Expansion
nodes.rationale: The matcher has no stemming, synonyms, or cross-language support, so the question is expanded against real graph vocabulary (never invented tokens) before traversal or the answer collapses to noise.

nodes.label: Discrete Confidence Score Rubric
nodes.rationale: A bimodal discrete scale (0.95/0.85/0.75/0.65/0.55) replaces continuous ranges because observed extractions collapsed to a binary; below 0.55 edges should be marked AMBIGUOUS instead.

nodes.label: Node ID Naming Convention
nodes.rationale: Full-repo-relative-path stems keep same-named files distinct and make IDs deterministic across chunks and runs, preventing orphan ghost-duplicate nodes.

nodes.label: Verbatim source_file Attribution Rule
nodes.rationale: Copying FILE_LIST paths character-for-character keeps the full build and incremental --update on the same base so build_merge's replace-on-re-extract matches existing nodes instead of accumulating duplicates.

nodes.label: EXTRACTED/INFERRED/AMBIGUOUS Audit Trail
nodes.rationale: Every edge carries an explicit confidence class so consumers can distinguish sourced facts from inference from uncertain readings.

nodes.label: Honesty Rules
nodes.rationale: Never invent an edge, never hide token cost or raw cohesion scores, and always surface graph-health warnings so the audit trail stays trustworthy.

nodes.label: Per-Subfolder Monorepo Extraction
nodes.rationale: Running the skill on each subfolder would clobber the shared graphify-out/ dir, so the CLI extracts per subfolder and merges at the project root.

nodes.label: Query-First Codebase Question Rule
nodes.rationale: graphify query/path/explain return a scoped subgraph usually much smaller than GRAPH_REPORT.md or raw grep output, so questions should hit the graph first when graph.json exists.
